_comment: Studio Unattended Loop settings (Kit v3). Copy to .claude/settings.json ONLY after the first dry loop has produced artifacts/EVIDENCE.md and artifacts/RUBRIC.md, because the Stop hook locks the door the moment this file exists. Edit the allow list to this project's real commands; keep ask and deny lists as written. The Stop hook runs the checking script first and the session-end report check second; keep both, in that order. The 30-minute timeout on the checking script is deliberate: if a project's checks take longer, raise it here and say so in DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md. The PostToolUse typecheck hook is advisory only (it warns, it never blocks).

hooks._comment: The session-end report hook (kit file 01): refuses a quiet close without a dated report in the corpus repo. Keep it, keep it last. If this project's report check has another name, point here at that.

hooks.command: npm run -s typecheck >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'typecheck is failing — fix it before moving on' >&2
